text:
marie: Drafted the launch blog + mini benchmark appendix: https://docs.google.com/launch-may. Need copy lock by Thu EOD so design can finalize hero and ops can prep webinar routing. Quick pass? :wave:

oliver: read and left a couple inline notes. One ask: can we surface p95 in the subhead to support the 'predictable' claim?

nina: uploading p50/p95 CSV into the doc now: https://drive.google.com/latency-may.csv. Note: sample excludes requests <50 tokens.

sam: HubSpot form ids for routing: demo -> 77881, webinar -> 77882. CTA mapping suggestion:
Top CTA: "Start free" -> no gate
Mid CTA: "Book demo" -> 77881 -> list: Demo_Inbound_May
Footer CTA: "Register webinar" -> 77882 -> list: Webinar_Registrants_May

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged phrase on para 2: "bank-grade isolation". Please replace or attach SOC2/audit link.

marie: Updated phrasing to "enterprise-grade controls" and added compliance link: https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2.

jamal: I'll create HubSpot workflows tonight. Plan: tag leads with campaign=launch_may_2026 and route demo leads to SDR_Inbound. Will add property source=launch_blog.

oliver: voting for headline B (shorter). design prefers short hero text to keep image readable.

marie: Great. Action owners: nina -> data upload (in progress), jamal -> workflows, oliver -> final copy pass. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is complete so I can close the loop. Thanks all!
